title: O bone et dulcis domine / Pater noster / Ave Maria...benedicta tu (Josquin)
desc: Josquin des Prez, O bone et dulcis domine / Pater noster / Ave Maria...benedicta tu. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Jos2108); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff. No text in this edition.
